title: 6 Signs Your Hustle Isn't the Work God Called You To
caption:
Grinding and working aren't the same thing, and most guys never stop long enough to tell which one they're actually doing.

Grinding can't stop even on the day God told you to rest. Its worth rises and falls with the output, an idol with a to-do list. It crowds out prayer, it can't say what it's actually for, and it costs you the people closest to you while telling you that's the price of ambition.

God's work in you never asks for your family as payment. If your hustle can't survive stillness in front of Him, it was never the calling. It was just motion.
